artifact.core.cornucopia.description:
{Cornucopia}

Counting component effects, {Cornucopia} increases its owner's daily production of mercury, sulfur, crystal, and gems by {5} of each resource.

In addition, each allied hero with a rare-resource production specialty provides the player controlling that hero with an additional {4} of every rare resource per day.

If the bearer of {Cornucopia} has such a specialty, both bonuses apply.

Additional bonuses from further specialists stack.
